stem: Which sentence shows that the narrator has been affected by the encounter with the salesperson?

options.label: A
options.text: I understood that I was having these thoughts only because of the stranger with the bony fingers and the worn-down heels, and as I went down to the hutch I felt a burst of irritation as I heard him say: "This is your lucky day."

options.label: B
options.text: Then he clicked his case shut and hurried out the door as if afraid I'd change my mind.

options.label: C
options.text: When he tried to sell me a second bottle, he understood from my look that it was time to go.

options.label: D
options.text: Two things struck me: the case must be very heavy, and he must not have sold anything in a long time.
